arguments.text: The statement was made in court ('told the jury'), which falls outside the definition of hearsay under FRE 801(c) because it explicitly excludes statements made while testifying at the current trial.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) exclusion for statements made while testifying at the current trial or hearing.

arguments.text: The statement contains a clear assertion of fact ('he didn't know the first thing about how medicines worked'), satisfying the assertion element required for hearsay.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) requirement that the declarant must assert or intend to assert a fact.
arguments.evidence_span: he didn't know the first thing about how medicines worked.

arguments.text: The statement is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted (whether Will knew about the cancelled drug trials), satisfying the purpose element required for hearsay.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) requirement that the proponent offers the statement to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
